challenge.better_approach: Ask the home box over the bus for the chain: the chart device is on the Dell, but a bus verb only reaches berths while the Dell is up and the LAN door is open, and every reader of chain_for_ticket would need a far-aware path. The commons is already the cross-box medium d692 chose for berths, so this reuses it.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the commons is pulled on the reading box before it reads: true for the voyage flow (pull first), and the falsifier is about the store, not git timing. Also that berths/chart/ is not a jurisdiction the artifact door refuses: d692 writes berths/sorted and berths/intent through the same door.
challenge.prior_art: d692ef650534 (cast_ticket copies sorted and intent berths to commons/berths/<skill>/<name>, read_berth falls back) is the sibling: same medium, different berths and reader. Its _carry_berths is in transitions.py and copies only the two cited berths; chart berths are written later, by codemother's stage writers, so they need their own carry.
challenge.real_collision: None. Berths in instance-space stay the source; the commons copy is a mirror, as for d692. Commons size grows by one file per chart stage per ticket (measured on the Dell: count recorded at build).

answers.falsifier: RED if a berth claiming a ticket, written on box A, is not found by chain_for_ticket on box B reading the same commons; or if an unclaimed berth is copied; or if a berth present in both stores is counted twice.
answers.from_idea: none, because the orchestrator relayed it from a measured refusal: 3195b3b834bc's hollow on akienasus said 'ticket 3195b3b834bc names no decompose berth' and sail.py verdict raised FileNotFoundError on ~/.cairn/devices/chart/0/packets/validate-20261112T205954-68e56653ee1c.json, because cairn/tools/chain/chain.py chain_for_ticket reads only the local store
answers.how: cairn/tools/chain/chain.py gains carry_berth(path): a berth whose packet names a ticket is copied through the artifact door to <CairnCommons>/berths/chart/<name>, as d692ef650534's _carry_berths does for sorted and intent berths. _packet_index over the default store also indexes that commons folder, deduped by basename. Each of the eight stage writers in codemother (orient, constrain, survey, decompose, triage, hypothesize, validate, verdict) calls carry_berth on the path it wrote. Red-first proof over a scratch store and scratch commons.
answers.traces_to: Law 7 (a reader may not report as absent a chain that exists: 'names no decompose berth' was false) and Law 1 (re-charting on the home box, or hand-copying berths, re-derives a settled chain).
answers.what: A chart berth that claims a ticket is readable from every box, so a hollow, verdict or chain read on a box other than the one that charted finds the chain instead of reading it as absent.

bullets.text: 3195's hollow and verdict could not run on akienasus: its chart berths are only on the Dell. The orchestrator had to run both there. A commons mirror of claiming chart berths lets any box read the chain.
